We will still have more optimizations incoming based on profiling devnet 7 and benchmarks on devnet 7 spec + few more optimization ideas from: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/11436#issuecomment-4398512462 https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/11436#issuecomment-4401374379 https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/11436#issuecomment-4401421566 https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/11436#issuecomment-4405040731 Besu has Hey everyone, I have been working on a EIP-7928 impl and have a quick question. wrt delegations, spec says: ``` EIP-7702 Delegations: The delegation target MUST NOT be included during delegation creation or modification **and MUST only be included once it is actually loaded as an execution target** (e.g., via CALL/CALLCODE/DELEGATECALL/STATICCALL under authority execution). ``` but in `tests/amsterdam/eip7928_block_level_access_lists/test_block_access_lists_opcodes.py::test_bal_call_revert_insufficient_funds[fork_Amsterdam-call_opcode_CALL-blockchain_test-delegated-cold_target-cold_delegation]` a CALL to an account with delegation fails due to the caller not having enough funds for the value transfer. But BAL still includes the authority address, even tho the code at authority was never needed to be read. I'm wondering if this was ever discussed?

excerpts.content:
Hey everyone, I have been working on a EIP-7928 impl and have a quick question.

wrt delegations, spec says:

```
EIP-7702 Delegations: The delegation target MUST NOT be included during delegation creation or modification **and MUST only be included once it is actually loaded as an execution target** (e.g., via CALL/CALLCODE/DELEGATECALL/STATICCALL under authority execution).
```

but in `tests/amsterdam/eip7928_block_level_access_lists/test_block_access_lists_opcodes.py::test_bal_call_revert_insufficient_funds[fork_Amsterdam-call_opcode_CALL-blockchain_test-delegated-cold_target-cold_delegation]` a CALL to an account with delegation fails due to the caller not having enough funds for the value transfer. But BAL still includes the authority address, even tho the code at authority was never needed to be read. I'm wondering if this was ever discussed?
